description: Address 5 code review issues: rest timer dead code, session history data gap, _showRestTimer state logic, SnackBar stacking, and warm-up sheet bypass
steps: Fix rest timer dead code by storing last session outcome locally in pushup_screen.dart and adding streamRecentPushupSessions to FirestoreService
Fix session history to show multiple entries by using a new stream in HealthProvider
Fix _showRestTimer state logic to properly control visibility and allow dismissal
Fix SnackBar stacking by calling clearSnackBars() before showing a new one in pushup_session_screen.dart
Fix warm-up sheet bypass by disabling the warm-up link when rest timer is active
acceptance_criteria: Rest timer shows after a failed session (not only after verified sessions)
Session history card can display multiple sessions
_showRestTimer properly hides the rest timer when dismissed
Only one SnackBar shows at a time during batch failures
Warm-up sheet cannot bypass rest timer lock
verification: Run `cd /projects/sandbox/Rapgate/firebase/functions && bun run build` to confirm TypeScript still compiles
Check Dart files for balanced braces and valid syntax
